recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: five-thousand-dollar dreams floated on autumn wind
lawyers reading fine print between headlines
conflicts waiting for calendar pages to turn
clear san francisco evening at twenty degrees
agent shortcuts humming quietly from a dormant phone

composer-2.5-fast.concept: A fog bank rolls across the screen — hold to part the mist and reveal hidden agent glyphs; release before the fog seals shut and the glyph vanishes.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each revealed glyph adds a syllable to an emergent 2026 prophecy phrase at round end
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog reforms faster each cycle, safe reveal windows shrink
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: milky glass morphism over amber sunset gradient

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort shipping crates onto dawn-bound conveyor belts before sunrise — wrong lane triggers a merge conflict burst that scatters your stack.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left or right to switch lanes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: sunrise deadline meter fills as perfectly sorted crates lock into place
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: crate types multiply and belt speed ramps as dawn approaches
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: isometric pixel dock with pre-dawn orange horizon

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw paths between parallel agent brains in the same chat — connect each brain to its task node without crossing wires or shorting the flow.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag finger to trace routes between nodes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: split-screen reveal shows each brain finishing the same micro-task differently
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more brains spawn mid-round, wires tangle and retract faster
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: split-screen wireframe synapse map on dark terminal green

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves into recycle bins while fine-print elastic bands bounce misfiled leaves back — land three clean shots to shred a document stack.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: satisfying shredding cascade when three leaves land in the same bin consecutively
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: elastic bands multiply and wind shifts trajectory mid-flight
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: courtroom-meets-origami collage in stained glass autumn palette
